svg.title: Violinist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as violinist, wearing a tailored jacket. Visible work cue: A waisted violin body, narrow neck and bridge sit beside a long separate bow. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face.
